examined_formations.title: NATIONAL_REGISTERED_DATA_PROPERTY_TO_MULTI_BANK_FINANCING_ROUTER
examined_formations.chinese_title: 全国数据产权登记结果 → 多银行数据资产融资路由
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The national data-property registry now creates a fresh searchable identity layer and current Shanghai/other cases prove substantial data-IP financing. However bank underwriting remains bespoke and incumbent data exchanges/banks already provide registration-to-assetization/financing services; no machine-callable multi-bank offer rail or proprietary financing outcome graph is evidenced.

attraction_brief.a_side: Registered data-right holders can want liquidity/value realization now; real firms have used data IP for pledge financing.
attraction_brief.a_side_evidence: Shanghai reported 24 enterprises using data IP for RMB547m pledge financing by end-July 2026; national registration launched with cross-industry applicants.
attraction_brief.b_side: Banks have an incentive to originate qualified light-asset SME credit and current banks advertise data-asset financing solutions.
attraction_brief.b_side_evidence: SPDB publicly offers data-asset enhancement/pledge financing and Shanghai organized direct enterprise-bank financing matches.
attraction_brief.operator: A cross-bank eligibility/control layer would be attractive only if it could machine-resolve eligibility and learn realized outcomes.
attraction_brief.operator_non_labor_test: Must not require manual valuation, bank-by-bank relationship selling or bespoke credit packaging for each borrower.
attraction_brief.connection_wow: A newly standardized public property identity could in theory turn hard-to-see data assets into financeable collateral candidates.
attraction_brief.activation_friction: Credit underwriting, valuation, compliance, bank onboarding and bilateral contracting remain substantial.
attraction_brief.self_propulsion: Would require permissioned realized approval/pricing/default outcomes; none are currently owned.

exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: National registration is operated through the national system and three selected registration institutions.
Shenzhen Data Exchange explicitly positions registration, circulation and assetization as a full-chain service.
SPDB already offers data-asset financing solutions and connects law firms, exchanges and valuation providers.
Shanghai public process still requires bank-specific questioning, value/credit assessment and contract execution.

examined_formations.title: ELECTRONIC_TRANSFERABLE_DOCUMENT_TO_COLLATERAL_FINANCE_ROUTER
examined_formations.chinese_title: 电子可转让货物单证 → 质押融资路由
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The electronic-document rules are newly effective and digital NCD financing has real money flow, but Chongqing's incumbent public infrastructure already integrates document control, pledge registration, verification and bank financing end to end.

attraction_brief.a_side: Light-asset trade/logistics firms want working capital against in-transit goods.
attraction_brief.a_side_evidence: The Chongqing mechanism reported more than RMB22m financing released since May 2026.
attraction_brief.b_side: Banks want verifiable title and pledge status before lending.
attraction_brief.b_side_evidence: The integrated platform lets financial institutions verify title/pledge records and Bank of China completed an eNCD pledge-financing transaction.
attraction_brief.operator: A router would only be attractive if multiple unconnected document and bank rails left a controllable missing edge.
attraction_brief.operator_non_labor_test: Must not manually inspect bills, negotiate individual bank acceptance or re-enter pledge records.
attraction_brief.connection_wow: Digitally controlled title can convert otherwise hard-to-finance in-transit goods into collateral.
attraction_brief.self_propulsion: Incumbent infrastructure, not an external operator, accumulates the registration/finance outcome loop.

examined_formations.title: GREEN_CERTIFICATE_BUYER_SUPPLY_ROUTER
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Green certificates have massive current issuance/trading and clear price formation, but the national system and recognized power exchanges already own identity, account, listing/bilateral/auction transaction and settlement synchronization.

attraction_brief.a_side: Renewable generators want to monetize eligible certificates.
attraction_brief.a_side_evidence: The national system reported 1.970bn certificates issued in 2026 through July.
attraction_brief.b_side: Electricity consumers buy certificates for renewable-consumption claims/requirements.
attraction_brief.b_side_evidence: 481m certificates were traded through July 2026, including 54.68m in July.
attraction_brief.operator: An independent router would need a cross-market decision/control asset beyond public price and official platform execution.
attraction_brief.operator_non_labor_test: No manual brokerage or bilateral negotiation as the recurring engine.
attraction_brief.connection_wow: Commodity environmental attributes already move at scale; the missing-edge hypothesis is weak.
attraction_brief.self_propulsion: Market data compounds mainly for official exchanges/market infrastructure.

examined_formations.title: PRODUCT_CARBON_FOOTPRINT_CERTIFICATION_ROUTER
examined_formations.chinese_title: 产品碳足迹标识认证机构匹配与办理路由
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The certification system is expanding with standardized rules and qualified institutions, but certification quality is a regulated expert-trust function. An external operator without certification authority collapses to lead generation/document consulting and recurring human coordination.

attraction_brief.a_side: Manufacturers in covered product classes have growing reasons to obtain trusted carbon-footprint labels.
attraction_brief.a_side_evidence: The national pilot has a general rule plus 17 product-specific rules across many industrial product classes.
attraction_brief.b_side: Qualified certification bodies seek legitimate certification business.
attraction_brief.b_side_evidence: The pilot created an authorized institution set subject to active capability supervision.
attraction_brief.operator: Attractive only if eligibility/data preparation can be machine-resolved while certification remains delegated.
attraction_brief.operator_non_labor_test: Must not become recurring LCA calculation, evidence collection, audit preparation or certification consulting.
attraction_brief.connection_wow: Standard rules could simplify selection, but the decisive trust work remains inside qualified institutions.
attraction_brief.self_propulsion: No permissioned certification outcome graph or action right is evidenced for an external router.

excluded_observations: Hubei launched a fresh province-wide culture-tourism+ platform with full search-to-reservation flow, but the platform itself already owns the advertised discovery and booking surface; no external missing edge was admitted.

2026 consumer trade-in subsidy flows remain digitally traceable, but are government/platform-controlled and overlap the project's existing used-device/recycling history, so they were excluded from fresh formation admission.

The 2026 SME fixed-asset loan interest-subsidy policy creates real financial incentive, but bank credit and policy eligibility remain lender/government-controlled and no distinct operator action rail was evidenced.
Repository code search returned no prior current-epoch artifact hits for 数据产权, 数据资产融资, 电子单证, 数字提单, 绿证 or 碳足迹认证 before Scan 127 selection.
